summary: This patch creates a new skill for produce lane restock gap analysis - a distinct variant from the existing supply-demand gap analysis. Key differences: (1) lane-level granularity vs SKU-level, (2) Load Status filtering (Ready/Docked vs Draft/Cancelled) vs Booking State (Firm/Locked vs Tentative/Hold), (3) Earlier_Delivery_Required compares required delivery date against earliest qualifying arrival per lane/SKU, not against AsOfDate. The trace shows the agent had to discover data structures through Python/openpyxl since direct Read failed on binary Excel files - this pattern is now captured as a reusable workflow.
